content: Written derivation: with D=floor(N^(1/3)), the ordered Mangoldt Goldbach sum equals N times the singular series minus the explicitly defined primitive large-divisor Mobius-Mangoldt tail, with O_A(N/log(N)^A) error from classical unconditional inputs. GRH gives an optional O_epsilon(N^(5/6+epsilon)) variant. H_muLambda, an unproved aggregate maximal correlation estimate, would make the tail o(N), hence Goldbach only for sufficiently large even N. The precise estimate, effective threshold, formalization and independent review are still missing. Exponent bookkeeping identifies an additional distribution requirement beyond 1/2 for a direct transfer matching Sawin-Shusterman coefficient-size hypotheses. A dense quadratic-character surrogate refutes a Fourier-only positivity shortcut, not Goldbach.
